repos.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，用于将各类文件（如 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML 等）转换为结构化的 Markdown 格式，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计。它支持 OCR、语音转文本、ZIP 内文件遍历及 YouTube 链接解析，注重保留文档结构（标题、表格、列表等），输出高度兼容主流大模型。
repos.summary_en: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts various file types (PDF, Office docs, images, audio, HTML, etc.) into structured Markdown for use with LLMs and text analysis pipelines. It supports OCR, speech-to-text, ZIP extraction, and YouTube URL conversion, preserving document structure like headings and tables for optimal LLM compatibility.

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome DESIGN.md 是一个精选的 DESIGN.md 文件集合，源自主流网站的设计系统。每个文件包含完整的视觉主题、色彩体系、排版规则、组件样式和响应式规范，AI 编码代理可直接读取生成像素级匹配的 UI。支持明暗模式预览，适用于快速复刻知名产品界面。
repos.summary_en: Awesome DESIGN.md is a curated collection of design system files from popular websites, each following Google Stitch's plain-text format. It includes visual themes, color palettes, typography rules, component styles, and responsive behavior, enabling AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs directly from markdown without Figma or JSON dependencies.

repos.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
repos.summary_zh: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
repos.summary_en: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

repos.description: Get your documents ready for gen AI
repos.summary_zh: Docling 是一个强大的文档处理工具，支持多种格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX等）的解析与理解，具备高级 PDF 布局分析、表格识别、OCR 及音频转文本功能。它提供统一的 DoclingDocument 输出格式，支持导出为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 等格式，并无缝集成 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等 AI 框架，专为生成式 AI 应用打造。
repos.summary_en: Docling is a powerful document processing tool that parses diverse formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, etc.) with advanced PDF layout analysis, table recognition, OCR, and ASR capabilities. It outputs unified DoclingDocument format, supports exports to Markdown, HTML, JSON, and integrates seamlessly with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other AI frameworks for gen AI applications.

repos.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为 Obsidian 设计的 Agent 技能集，支持 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 和 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 框架，实现知识管理与自动化处理的无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: This repo delivers agent skills for Obsidian, enabling creation and editing of Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas files, and CLI interactions. Fully compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via the Agent Skills specification.

repos.description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
repos.summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
repos.summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

repos.description: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
repos.summary_zh: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
repos.summary_en: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

repos.description: Documentation that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
repos.summary_en: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF to clean Markdown. Built in Rust, with Node.js and Python bindings.
repos.summary_zh: anydoc 是基于 Rust 的高性能文档转换库，支持 Word、PDF、Excel 等 8 种格式一键转为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。提供 Node.js、Python、WebAssembly 多语言绑定，毫秒级响应，专为 LLM 数据预处理和 AI Agent 集成设计，是 Firecrawl Parse 的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: anydoc is a high-performance Rust library that converts 8+ document formats (Word, PDF, Excel, etc.) into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown in single-digit milliseconds. Offers Node.js, Python, and WebAssembly bindings, purpose-built for LLM data preprocessing and AI Agent integration, powering Firecrawl Parse.

repos.description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

repos.summary_zh: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
repos.summary_en: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
repos.summary_zh: 赫蹏（Heti）是一款专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强库。它基于通行的中文排版规范，提供贴合网格的排版、全标签美化、古文诗词样式及竖排等功能。通过引入CSS与可选的JS脚本，可自动实现中西文混排优化与全角标点挤压，大幅提升网页中文阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: Heti is a typography enhancement library specifically designed for Chinese content display. Based on standard Chinese typesetting conventions, it offers grid-aligned layouts, full tag styling, and specialized formats for classical poetry and vertical writing. By including its CSS and optional JS, it automatically optimizes CJK-Latin mixed spacing and punctuation compression, significantly improving the reading experience.

repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
repos.summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

repos.description: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
repos.summary_zh: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: Kode CLI — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode CLI 是一款面向后人类工作流的终端 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可自动理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并管理完整工作流。原生支持多平台与 20+ AI 模型，兼容 .claude 旧格式，具备子代理任务编排能力，适用于自动化编码与智能体协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Kode CLI is a terminal-based AI coding assistant designed for post-human workflows. It understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and manages full development workflows. It natively supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with 20+ AI models, and enables autonomous task orchestration via subagents.

repos.description: 中文网页重设与排版 CSS，面向现代中文阅读优化字体、行高、CJK 断行、中西文间距与着重号。
repos.summary_zh: typo.css 是一个专为中文网页设计的样式重置与排版工具，旨在统一浏览器渲染差异，优化中文阅读体验。它提供完整的 reset 样式、阅读内容排版类 `.typo` 及专名号、着重号等中文排版增强功能，支持桌面与移动端，适用于文章、文档等长文本场景。
repos.summary_en: typo.css is a CSS framework designed for Chinese web typography, aiming to standardize browser rendering and optimize readability. It offers a complete reset, a `.typo` class for article layouts, and enhancements like underlines for proper nouns and emphasis marks, supporting both desktop and mobile platforms.

repos.description: A Python implementation of John Gruber’s Markdown with Extension support.
repos.summary_zh: Python-Markdown 是 Python 实现的 John Gruber 官方 Markdown 语法解析器，高度兼容参考实现，支持扩展机制，提供简洁的 API 将 Markdown 文本转换为标准 HTML，广泛用于文档生成、静态站点构建和内容管理系统。
repos.summary_en: Python-Markdown is a Python implementation of John Gruber's Markdown, nearly fully compliant with the reference implementation. It supports extensible syntax via plugins, offering a clean API to convert Markdown text into HTML, widely used in documentation, static site generation, and content management systems.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版工具，能将 Markdown 一键转换为可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。它提供 6 套精选主题及自定义主题生成器，通过全内联样式与特定标签规避平台过滤，并具备章节编号、关键词标记及双关卡质量校验功能，确保排版的高保真与一致性。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready WeChat Official Account HTML. It features 6 preset themes and a custom theme generator, utilizing inline styles and specific tags to bypass platform filters. With auto-numbering, keyword marking, and dual-stage quality validation, it ensures high-fidelity, consistent formatting for content creators.

repos.description: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.
repos.summary_zh: html-to-markdown 是一款强大的 HTML 到 Markdown 转换工具，支持完整网页转换、复杂格式处理、自定义选项和插件扩展。提供 Golang 库、CLI 工具和在线 API 三种使用方式，具备智能转义、表格支持、嵌套列表等高级功能，适用于内容提取、文档转换等场景。
repos.summary_en: html-to-markdown is a robust HTML-to-Markdown converter that transforms entire websites into clean, readable Markdown with support for complex formatting, customizable options, and extensible plugins. It offers a Golang library, CLI tool, and hosted REST API, featuring smart escaping, table conversion, nested lists, and relative-to-absolute link resolution.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Visual Skills Pack 是一个实验性插件，通过 Claude Code 将文本自动转换为 Excalidraw（手绘风格）、Mermaid（流程图）和 Canvas（彩色卡片布局）三种可视化图表。支持中文文本处理、动画生成及多输出模式，适用于思维导图、流程设计、系统架构等场景，显著提升知识表达效率。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Visual Skills Pack is an experimental plugin that uses Claude Code to automatically convert text into three types of visual diagrams: Excalidraw (hand-drawn style), Mermaid (flowcharts), and Canvas (colorful card layout). It supports Chinese text, animations, multiple output modes, and is ideal for mind maps, workflows, and system architecture visualization.

repos.description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
repos.summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
repos.summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: README file generator, powered by AI.
repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

repos.description: markdown2: A fast and complete implementation of Markdown in Python
repos.summary_zh: markdown2 是一个高性能、完整的 Python Markdown 解析器，严格遵循原始 Perl 实现的行为。支持丰富的扩展语法（如代码高亮、表格、脚注等），兼容 Python 3.5+，提供模块和命令行两种使用方式，适合快速将 Markdown 转换为结构化的 HTML。
repos.summary_en: markdown2 is a fast, complete Python implementation of Markdown that closely matches the original Perl version. It supports numerous extras like syntax highlighting, tables, and footnotes, works with Python 3.5+, and offers both module and CLI usage for converting Markdown to HTML.

repos.description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
repos.summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
repos.summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

repos.description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
repos.summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
repos.summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.description: 一款基于 AI 技术的 Web 应用程序，可将文本内容智能转换为 Mermaid 格式的代码，并将其渲染成可视化图表。
repos.summary_zh: Smart Mermaid 是一款基于 AI 的 Web 应用，可将自然语言文本智能转换为 Mermaid 图表代码并实时渲染。支持流程图、序列图等多种图表类型，提供标准 SVG 与手绘风格双渲染器，具备 AI 代码修复、优化及文件导入功能，适合快速生成可视化图表。
repos.summary_en: Smart Mermaid is an AI-powered web app that converts natural language text into Mermaid diagram code and renders it visually. It supports multiple chart types, dual rendering modes (SVG and hand-drawn), AI-assisted code fixing/optimization, and file import, enabling efficient text-to-diagram conversion for technical documentation and planning.

repos.description: 文颜- Markdown文章排版美化工具，支持微信公众号、今日头条、知乎等平台。
repos.summary_zh: 文颜是一款专为 Markdown 内容创作者设计的排版美化工具，支持一键将 Markdown 文章转换为适配微信公众号、知乎、今日头条等主流平台的富文本格式，内置多款 Typora 主题并支持自定义样式，自动处理图片上传与数学公式渲染，让写作者专注于内容创作而非繁琐排版。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan is a Markdown formatting and publishing tool designed for content creators, enabling one-click conversion of Markdown articles into platform-specific rich text formats for WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Toutiao, and more. It features built-in Typora themes, custom styling, automatic image uploads, MathJax support, and seamless cross-platform publishing.

repos.description: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具
repos.summary_zh: 该工具利用 Camoufox 实现反检测抓取，自动提取微信公众号文章的标题、账号、发布时间及原文链接，并将 HTML 内容转换为结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，同时下载图片至本地并重写链接，支持代码块语法高亮，适用于内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This tool uses Camoufox for anti-detection fetching to extract WeChat Official Account articles, converting HTML content into clean Markdown with metadata (title, account, publish time, URL), downloading images locally, and preserving code blocks with language syntax. Ideal for content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: An open-source presentation theme ecosystem for Marp/Markdown users.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Marp 是一个基于 Markdown 的演示文稿工具，提供 38 种自定义 CSS 样式和 6 种主题，支持分栏布局、导航进度、封面页、目录页及定理框等，可替代 LaTeX Beamer。配套 VS Code 和 Obsidian，支持字体自定义，适合高效制作美观幻灯片。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Marp is a Markdown-based presentation tool offering 38 custom CSS styles and 6 themes, supporting multi-column layouts, navigation progress bars, cover pages, table of contents, and callout boxes. It replaces LaTeX Beamer with enhanced styling, integrates with VS Code and Obsidian, and allows font customization for professional slides.

repos.description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
repos.summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
repos.summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.description: Claude Code 公众号一键排版+发布技能 | Markdown → 微信兼容 HTML → 推送草稿箱 | 30 套主题 + 可视化画廊
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的微信公众号一键排版工具，支持 Markdown 转微信兼容 HTML、30 套主题可视化预览、AI 内容增强（对话/图片容器）及直接推送草稿箱，覆盖新闻、科技、设计等多场景风格。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for seamless WeChat Official Account publishing: converts Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML, offers 30 visual themes with AI-enhanced content (dialogue/gallery containers), and enables one-click draft publishing via WeChat API.

repos.description: A Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG and SVG output — no browser, no Chromium, no DOM.
repos.summary_zh: marknative 是一个原生 Markdown 渲染引擎，无需浏览器或 DOM，直接生成分页的 PNG/SVG 文档。它通过自建排版引擎实现确定性分页和头less服务端渲染，支持 CommonMark + GFM 语法，适用于 API 文档、电子书等需要精确控制排版的场景。
repos.summary_en: marknative is a native Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG/SVG output without requiring a browser, Chromium, or DOM. It parses Markdown into an internal document model, runs its own layout and pagination engine, and paints pages using Skia Canvas. Ideal for deterministic, server-side rendering of technical docs, e-books, and reports.

repos.summary_zh: Web Content Fetcher 是一个轻量级网页正文提取工具，支持自动将任意网页转换为标准 Markdown 格式。采用 Scrapling 优先策略（fast/stealth 双模式自动降级），并集成 Jina Reader 作为备选方案，完美适配微信公众号、掘金、CSDN 等国内主流平台及海外技术站点。
repos.summary_en: Web Content Fetcher is a lightweight tool for extracting clean Markdown content from web pages. It prioritizes Scrapling with fast/stealth dual-mode auto-fallback, integrates Jina Reader as backup, and supports major Chinese platforms like WeChat Official Accounts, Juejin, and CSDN, plus global tech sites.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: A Python binding for Hoedown.
repos.summary_zh: Misaka 是一个已停止维护的 Python 绑定库，用于 Hoedown 的 Markdown 解析器。它提供高性能的 Markdown 转 HTML 功能，适用于需要轻量级、快速解析的场景。尽管项目不再更新，仍可作为历史参考或特定环境下的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Misaka is a discontinued Python binding for the Hoedown Markdown parser, offering fast and lightweight Markdown-to-HTML conversion. Though no longer maintained, it remains a historical reference or alternative for specific use cases where performance is critical.

repos.description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
repos.summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

repos.description: Local-first Windows WeChat memory archive with traceable PDF, Markdown, and JSON exports｜本地优先的微信个人记忆库
repos.summary_zh: 微信 AI 记忆库是一款本地优先的桌面工具，直接从 Windows 微信 4.x 读取聊天记录，支持按会话、日期和关键词筛选，可导出 PDF、Markdown 与结构化 JSON。全程仅操作临时数据库副本，图片恢复、语音转写（faster-whisper）均在本机完成，无任何数据上传。
repos.summary_en: WeChat AI Memory is a local-first desktop tool that directly reads Windows WeChat 4.x chat data, supports filtering by conversation, date, and keywords, and exports to PDF, Markdown, and structured JSON. All operations—including image recovery and voice transcription via faster-whisper—stay on-device with zero data uploads.

repos.description: WeSpy 是一个用于获取wx公众号文章并转换为 Markdown 格式的 Python 工具
repos.summary_zh: WeSpy 是一个专为微信公众号设计的 Python 工具，可抓取文章并转换为 Markdown 格式，支持防盗链处理、专辑批量下载及多格式输出（Markdown/HTML/JSON），提供命令行和 Python API 两种使用方式。
repos.summary_en: WeSpy is a Python tool designed for scraping WeChat Official Account articles and converting them to Markdown format. It supports anti-hotlinking image handling, batch album downloads, and multi-format output (Markdown/HTML/JSON), with both CLI and Python API interfaces.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频（使用自己的APIKEY），编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 提示词的 AI 语音输入工具，支持多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，实现专有词汇、术语、人名及数字格式的一次性精准转录，内置 AI 图像文字提取功能，可智能修复断行与还原代码结构，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台，用户自备 API Key，数据直连服务商，安全高效。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is an AI-powered voice input tool driven by Markdown prompts, using multimodal LLMs to process raw audio directly for accurate transcription of names, jargon, and formatting in one pass. It includes AI-based text extraction from images, intelligently restoring broken lines and code structure. Supports macOS, Windows, and iOS with user-provided API keys for secure, direct cloud processing.

repos.description: A django app that provides Markdown-related template tags using the python-markdown2 library.
repos.summary_zh: django-markdown-deux 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，基于 python-markdown2 库提供 Markdown 模板标签支持。它允许在 Django 模板中通过 `markdown` 过滤器或块标签渲染 Markdown 内容，并支持自定义样式配置，适用于需要统一 Markdown 渲染选项的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-markdown-deux is a lightweight Django app that provides Markdown template tags using the python-markdown2 library. It enables rendering Markdown in Django templates via the `markdown` filter or block tag, with support for customizable styles via configuration, ideal for consistent Markdown processing across templates.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频。编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，利用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，支持自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略。通过编辑 Markdown 提示词，实现人名、术语、数字格式等一次性精准转写，减少二次修改，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is a Markdown-driven AI voice input tool that uses multimodal large models to directly process raw audio. It supports custom vocabulary, transcription rules, and formatting strategies via editable Markdown prompts. Achieving accurate, one-time transcription of names, terms, and numbers without post-processing, it runs on macOS, Windows, and iOS.

repos.description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
repos.summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
repos.summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

repos.description: Markdown  在线阅读器
repos.summary_zh: 在线 Markdown 阅读器支持代码高亮、目录自动生成、本地图片显示及导出 HTML，并集成 Todo 列表、MathJax 公式、时序图、Emoji 和 ECharts 图表等扩展语法，提供丰富的富文本阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: An online Markdown reader featuring code highlighting, auto-generated table of contents, local image support, HTML export, and rich extensions including Todo lists, MathJax, sequence diagrams, Emoji, and ECharts visualizations.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.
